name: lookup_patient
description: Search the practice's Practice Fusion FHIR endpoint for Patient resources matching caller-provided identity inputs (name, date of birth, phone). Returns a candidate list; the agent reasons over the candidates to decide match/no-match/ambiguous (see ADR-0013). The Lambda enforces per-(practice, ANI) rate-limit and writes one audit-disclosure record per FHIR probe (see ADR-0009).

practice_id.description: Tenant identifier resolved from the dialed DID by the contact flow (ADR-0014). REQUIRED. The Lambda uses this to look up per-practice FHIR base URL and OAuth tokens.

call_id.description: Amazon Connect contact id for the current call. REQUIRED. Used as the audit-record correlation key.

caller_phone.description: Caller ANI in E.164 (e.g. '+15551234567'). REQUIRED. Used for rate-limit keying and as a FHIR telecom search probe.

name_first.description: Caller-provided given name. Optional but recommended; the agent should collect it during verification.

name_last.description: Caller-provided family name. Optional but recommended.

date_of_birth.description: Caller-provided date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD. Optional but recommended; the agent should collect it during verification.

status.description: One of: 'candidates' (one or more matches; review the list), 'rate_limited' (per-(practice,ANI) budget exceeded — do not retry within the window), 'credentials_expired' (practice's PF refresh token is invalid; ask the caller to call back later), 'error' (transient failure; the agent may retry once).

candidates.description: List of candidate Patient records that matched any FHIR probe. May be empty. Each candidate carries enough fields for the agent to disambiguate; see ADR-0013 for the reasoning policy.

phone_masked.description: Last four digits only; never disclose the full phone aloud.

probe_origin.description: Which FHIR probe surfaced this candidate (e.g., 'telecom', 'family+given'). For agent context only.

probes_tried.description: FHIR probe templates exercised (audit + debug). Never includes raw PHI values.
